duplicate_selector_findings.decision: ADVISORY ONLY - not auto-applied this run.
duplicate_selector_findings.rationale: Per the ux-audit skill (3.5 dead-CSS rule): cross-file selector consolidation ships as its own per-slice PR with browser verification of the affected page at multiple viewports. Most identical-body duplicates live in stylesheets that load on DIFFERENT page contexts (e.g. archive-service.css vs buyer-request.css each load on their own archive page and are self-contained for that page; vendor-dashboard.css vs frontend.css load on different surfaces). Removing a rule from one file would only be safe where the consuming page ALSO loads the owning file as a hard dependency, which holds for very few pairs. The 235 different-body cases are intentional page-scoped overrides and must NOT be merged. Consolidating cross-page-scope stylesheets without per-page Playwright verification risks visual regressions, which violates the verify-per-item rule. Logged as known gaps for a dedicated, browser-verified consolidation slice.
